 Home News Wearable Devices Vivo Watch GT2 tipped to launch alongside X500 series: Check expected price, features and more details
 By Bhaskar Sharma | Updated on 04-Nov-2026 Add Digit as a 
preferred source Follow Us Vivo is reportedly planning to launch its first smartwatch in India. While the company has not officially confirmed anything yet, a tipster has recently claimed that the Vivo Watch GT2 could arrive alongside the upcoming Vivo X500 series. Leaks suggest that the wearable could feature a 2.07-inch AMOLED display with a rectangular design. It's also rummoured to be priced under Rs 20,000, making it an interesting option in the mid-range smartwatch segment. Here’s everything we know so far about the upcoming Vivo Watch GT2.
 Vivo Watch GT2: India launch timeline and price
 According to tipster Sanju Chaudhary, Vivo is gearing up to launch its Watch GT 2 alongside the upcoming Vivo X500 series, which is tipped to debut in India on November 25. If the leaks are anything to go by, the smartwatch could be priced under Rs 20,000. However, these details have not been officially confirmed by the company and should be treated as speculation for now.
 Also read: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 5 14IMH10 available with over Rs 30,000 discount during Flipkart Diwali sale, check details 
 Vivo Watch GT2: Specs
 The Vivo Watch GT2 might launch with a 2.07-inch AMOLED display, which is said to be rectangular. It's also anticipated that the display will be able to reach a peak brightness of 2400 nits. For the health-conscious people, the device may come with sensors that can track accelerometer, gyro, heart rate, compass, and SpO2.  
 The smartwatch is said to come with a 595 mAh battery on the eSIM variants, while the Bluetooth version may feature a 695 mAh cell. Leaks also point out that the device with eSIM can last for up to 8 days on one charge, while the Bluetooth-only model could last for up to 33 days in a controlled environment.
 Also read: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra leaks: iPhone-like camera island to Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, 5 changes to expect 
 Vivo is expected to ship its upcoming Watch GT2 with BlueOS 3.0. Not only that, but the rumours also point out that the device may also feature over 100 sports models. For connectivity it may get Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BDS and QZSS. 
 The wearable is also anticipated to have certifications for water and dust protection. The smartwatch is said to be compatible with both Android and iOS devices and rumoured to come in three colourways, notably the Glossy Black (eSIM only), Matte Silver, and Matte Dark Blue.
